revision_reason: Keep revision-1 FAIL. Classify explicit SITL pre-MAVLink startup ASCII, request read-only telemetry as in the original mission, and check host boundary coverage; no continuity or timestamp gate is relaxed.

cases.purpose: Deterministic communication input through original adapter and MAVROS
Original FAST-LIO with rendered sensors and recording, without mission or execution nodes

conditional_case.when: Only if lean synthetic passes and full LIO fails, to distinguish source effects from traffic/load

scope: Communication diagnosis only. A proxy changes the TCP path and observers change DDS participants. Success cannot retroactively repair R2B3B1 or establish flight stability.
pairing: adapter wall stamp ns // 1000 equals MAVLink ODOMETRY time_usec equals FCU VISP/VISV RTimeUS; preserve original LIO acquisition stamp separately
clock_policy: Use monotonic time for ROS/proxy intervals and AP boot TimeUS for FCU intervals; never subtract uncalibrated clocks as end-to-end latency
tail_policy: PASS is limited to the first-last observed SYSTEM_TIME FCU boot subwindow. Its first/last messages must be within maximum_boundary_wall_age_s of the frozen host window edges; report uncovered host edge durations. Missing/stale edges cannot receive continuity PASS.
failure_policy: Preserve every attempt. Never replace the failed latest flight with a successful diagnostic. No new armed trial in this stage.
